description: Three scene images and one redacted test-bench screenshot per language, shared by the website and public repository. A research overview, not a development log or evaluation dataset.
evidence_limit: Development stills show the setting and character relationships; they do not validate complete tasks, synchronized speech or research benefits.

items.caption_en: The restaurant prototype. These development stills show the setting and character relationships, not validation of complete tasks or synchronized speech.
items.caption_zh: 餐厅原型总览。以下开发静帧呈现场景与角色关系，不作为完整任务或语音同步的验证。

items.caption_en: Conversation sits within a shared table setting, where character orientation, distance and nearby objects provide context for interaction.
items.caption_zh: 对话被放在具体的餐桌情境中，角色的朝向、距离与周围对象共同构成互动背景。

items.caption_en: Guests and service staff inhabit the same environment. Their relationships provide a setting for examining authored intentions and action choices.
items.caption_zh: 顾客与服务人员处于同一环境，角色之间的关系为研究作者意图与行动选择提供语境。

items.caption_en: A development screenshot of the test bench: an older body idles in a ‘museum duty’ situation, hands behind the back. Internal values and action names are hidden, and the interface labels are translated into English for this page. The character is an existing asset.
items.caption_zh: 实验台的开发截图：老年身体在“博物馆值班”的情境中自主待机，双手背在身后。内部数值与动作名称已隐去；角色为既有资产。
